verdict.summary: The raw diagnostic path fails closed on manifest/schema/label/completeness errors, binds same-domain evaluation to the checkpoint manifest and declared content identity, rehashes every selected JPEG, and keeps default full evaluation behavior. Recomputed stored metrics and GT/ignore rows match. Results remain development diagnostics only.

checkpoint.final_process_check: No python process whose executable path was the dedicated road_yolo_venv was present at the final review check.

same_domain_subset.manifest_binding: The current full dataset JSON SHA-256 must equal checkpoint.dataset_sha256 before evaluation.
same_domain_subset.schema_and_labels: audit(payload) scans every declared row and validates detection schema, class order, label/box alignment, finite positive half-open boxes, ignore metadata, and incomplete-frame count; the subset loader additionally restricts all rows to train/val raw_image rows with SHA-256 source hashes and rejects scene leakage.
same_domain_subset.declared_content_identity: All declared (normalized image path, source_sha256) pairs reproduce checkpoint.dataset_content_sha256 without opening unselected pixels.
same_domain_subset.current_byte_scope: Only selected validation JPEGs are rehashed and decoded. Train and unselected validation JPEG pixels are not read by the subset path.
same_domain_subset.report_scope: image_verification_scope explicitly says selected_raw_val_bytes_only; other_hashes_manifest_declared. This is not a full current-content audit.

development_domain_subset.guard: Requires explicit --development-domain together with positive --max-images; all rows must still be eligible raw train/val rows and selected JPEG hashes must match their manifest declarations.
development_domain_subset.identity_reporting: The evaluation manifest SHA is separate from checkpoint training_dataset_sha256 and training_dataset_content_sha256; dataset_content_sha256 is null rather than pretending the development domain matches training content.
development_domain_subset.acceptance: status remains diagnostic_not_formal_acceptance and acceptance_eligible is false.

selection.rule: Sort validation rows by image string and choose floor(i*N/K), i=0..K-1.
selection.warning: This is left-edge systematic sampling, not random, stratified, endpoint-symmetric, or an unbiased population sample. Sorted names can correlate with source/capture order. Subset metrics have no sampling confidence interval.

preprocess_and_postprocess.preprocess: FullFrameDataset uses the training raw path: JPEG BGR decode, RGB conversion, explicit 1280x720 letterbox, bit-exact area resize to 512x288, then minus 128.
preprocess_and_postprocess.inference: FP32 CNN outputs are quantized to Q7.8 before the frozen integer decoder; this is not an INT8-CNN accuracy result.
preprocess_and_postprocess.class_order_binding: RoadYOLOS4 architecture_hash includes classes [person, vehicle] and output order [tx, ty, tw, th, objectness, person, vehicle].

implementation_checks.metrics: P/R at score 0.5 and AP50/AP50:95 are emitted even when no P95 operating threshold exists. The formal metrics field remains null when either class has no P95 threshold; the diagnostic report remains non-accepting.
implementation_checks.default_full_mode: With --max-images 0, the existing load_dataset_manifest path remains active and rehashes all manifest image bytes before evaluation. The final reviewed source only labels subset_selection and appends subset-bias text when image_count is less than total_validation_images.
implementation_checks.output_safety: Output uses exclusive creation mode and refuses an existing output path.

independent_test_runs.result: 4 passed; repeated after the final metadata fix with the same result

coco_val5000.historical_metadata_note: This run started before the final metadata-only source fix. Its validation_subset is correctly false, but subset_selection is still non-null and postprocess_contract is absent. This review records the actual contract; the stored predictions and recomputed metrics are unaffected. It used the raw max-images path, so all 5000 val bytes, but not train bytes, were currently reverified.

visdrone_val256_development_domain.timing_note: Threads=2 was intentionally used concurrently with the COCO full-val threads=4 run. Its timing is not threads=4 evidence; metric definitions are unchanged.

global_gt_comparison.interpretation: The selected GT count and size mix is close to the full declared val distribution, but temporal/name correlation and lack of randomization still prevent a representative-sample claim.

max32_structural_recall_ceiling.warning: Even a perfect ranker cannot reach R85 for vehicle on this subset under max_boxes_per_class=32. This development-domain result cannot be used for the P95/R85 acceptance gate.

findings.evidence: For COCO N=5000,K=256 the rule selects indices 0..4980 and omits the last 19 sorted rows. Vehicle score-0.5 precision/recall changed from 0.5556/0.0368 on 256 images to 0.2941/0.00758 on all 5000.
findings.disposition: Keep subset metrics diagnostic only; use the completed all-5000 report for COCO validation conclusions.

findings.evidence: VisDrone selected vehicle GT=10783, and 147/256 images contain more than 32 vehicle GT. Per-class max32 yields a theoretical vehicle recall ceiling of 0.643327.
findings.disposition: Do not interpret VisDrone P95/R85 as an acceptance test unless the fixed deployment postprocess contract changes; retain it only as a domain diagnostic.

findings.evidence: COCO full validation found person threshold 0.84 with precision 1.0 but recall 0.0000928; vehicle has no P95 threshold. Formal metrics is therefore null and acceptance_eligible=false.
findings.disposition: The epoch-6 checkpoint has detection metrics now, but does not meet accuracy acceptance.

findings.evidence: The all-5000 report began before the final metadata-only fix, so it says subset_selection even though validation_subset=false and omits postprocess_contract.
findings.disposition: No inference or metric rerun is required. Use this companion review plus the final evaluate.py snapshot for the corrected scope/contract.

remaining_risk: The evaluator hashes selected JPEG bytes before decoding them, so a concurrent file replacement between hash and decode is a residual local TOCTOU risk. No such drift was observed. The stored diagnostics are float-CNN plus fixed-point decoder results, not INT8-CNN, FPGA throughput, formal road acceptance, or newtest evidence.
